criteria.requirement: Add opt-in markdown.extensions.uri_autolink with UriAutolinkExtension(schemes=(http,https,ssh,urn)). Match complete angle-bracket URI syntax before raw-HTML handling but after code/escapes, use per-instance case-insensitive validated scheme allowlists, and build ElementTree anchor attributes/AtomicString text through the real serializer. Forbid javascript/vbscript/data even if requested; unsupported schemes do not become links, ordinary HTML/email/standard autolinks keep existing semantics, and code spans/blocks never expand. No global lexer mutation or network access. Clearly state this policy controls new autolinks only and does not sanitize Markdown raw HTML as a whole.
